method.engine: ALCHEMI (nvalchemi-toolkit 0.2.0 MACEWrapper, batched GPU); cross-check with mace-torch 0.3.15 ASE calculator
method.protocol: static 0 K E(V) scan of the diamond-cubic cell (17 points, isotropic strain +/-2/4/6% around a=5.43 A) + 3rd-order Birch-Murnaghan EOS fit; Vinet/Murnaghan fits and ASE BFGS+FrechetCellFilter cell relaxation (fmax 1e-5) as checks
method.ensemble: static lattice (0 K, no zero-point or thermal vibrations)

payload.note: Best estimate a0 = 5.467 A (BM3, +/-4% window: 5.4666 A; +/-2% window: 5.4673 A; ASE cell relaxation: 5.4674 A; 64-atom supercell: identical to 8-atom; residual pressure at 5.4666 A = 0.04 GPa, i.e. ~0.001 A). The uncertainty (0.001 A) covers only the numerical part: EOS form (BM3/Vinet/Murnaghan), fit window (2-6%), cell size, and code path (spread 5.4654-5.4674 A). It does NOT cover model error. The model is trained on PBE data and gives the PBE-level answer, not the experimental one: it is +0.036 A (+0.66%) above the CODATA 2018 Si lattice parameter 5.431020511(89) A (22.5 C, vacuum; NIST CODATA X-ray values), consistent with PBE's known ~0.6% overestimate for Si. Validation with the same setup recovers known PBE-type trends: Ge 5.720 A vs experimental 5.6574 A (+1.1%; PBE is reported to overestimate Ge by >1%); Cu 3.639 A (published PBE ~3.63 A, from a secondary source); Al 4.038 A; diamond C 3.578 A. Zero-point and thermal expansion to 295 K were not computed; they would shift the value slightly upward, by a few mA, so the PBE bias dominates the gap to experiment. For a property compared to experiment, use about +/-0.04 A as the realistic total uncertainty. Scripts: /work/scripts/eos.py, /work/scripts/ase_check.py; raw fits: /work/run/eos_results.json.

summary: Si lattice_constant = 5.467 angstrom via ALCHEMI (nvalchemi-toolkit 0.2.0 MACEWrapper, batched GPU); cross-check with mace-torch 0.3.15 ASE calculator/MACE-MPA-0 (medium), float64 static 0 K E(V) scan of the diamond-cubic cell (17 points, isotropic strain +/-2/4/6% around a=5.43 A) + 3rd-order Birch-Murnaghan EOS fit; Vinet/Murnaghan fits and ASE BFGS+FrechetCellFilter cell relaxation (fmax 1e-5) as checks
